title: Paleontologists discover “one-in-a-million” fossil with 450-million-year-old soft tissue
caption:
A crinoid fossil over 450 million years old still shows its tiny tube feet, something scientists see only once in a million specimens. The find reshapes how we picture feeding on early reefs, even if it’s just a single example.

Source: Sciencedaily - Paleontologists discover “one-in-a-million” fossil with 450-million-year-old soft tissue

https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/11/261105085201.htm
